Indic shaper: consonant-syllable reordering and staged features.

Ports harfrust ot/shaper/indic.rs: vowel-constraint preprocessing and matra decompose/compose hooks feed normalization; syllables are found during GSUB, initial reordering moves pre-base matras/reph, the 17 shaping features apply in HarfBuzz stages constrained to syllables, and final reordering settles matras, reph, and pref.

../buffer, ../feature, ../font, ../script, ../tag, ../unicode, apply, gsub, indic_machine, map, maskbits, shaper, syllabic, vowel_constraints

  config*: IndicConfig       ## Script configuration.
  isOldSpec*: bool           ## True for old spec fonts.
  zeroContext*: bool         ## True when context probes ignore surroundings.
  lookups*: array[17, seq[uint16]] ## Feature lookups per shaping stage.
  wouldBlwf*: seq[uint16]    ## Blwf probing lookups.
  wouldVatu*: seq[uint16]    ## Vatu probing lookups.
